statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I34.0 (nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency) was submitted
The diagnosis code R42 (dizziness and giddiness) was submitted
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
